diagnosis.what_happened: Command bans prevented absolute deletion and unlinking of stale validation reports.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Dynamic invariant rules intended to prevent creation of files accidentally blocked deletion/unlinking commands, leading to rule deadlock preventing decontamination.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Deletion/unlinking of stale validation reports should be exempt from command bans so decontamination can occur cleanly.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Stale reports must be removed to avoid false feedback loops. Security invariants should not prevent cleanup operations.

desired_behavior: Exempt absolute deletion and unlinking of stale validation reports from command bans so decontamination can occur cleanly.
generalization: Decontamination and cleanup commands must be explicitly exempted from restrictive creation/modification invariant rules to avoid deadlocks.
